title: Time — Hours and Half Hours
description: Learn the parts of an analog clock, read and show times to the hour and half hour, and match analog clocks with digital times.
learningFocus: Tell and write time in hours and half hours using analog and digital clocks, including the position of the hour and minute hands.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to point to each clock hand and explain what it shows. For half-hour times, help them notice that the minute hand points to 6 while the hour hand sits between the hour just passed and the next hour, then practice with a real clock.

seo.title: Time — Hours and Half Hours | Grade 1 Worksheets
seo.description: Five printable Grade 1 time worksheets for clock parts, o'clock times, half past, showing time, and matching analog clocks.
